Rusty Rutherford emerged from his apartment...
Rusty Rutherford was not normally the type of guy...
The team's temporary base had been established...
Goodyear escorted Reacher back to the booking area...
Speranski was back in his living room...
The same time Reacher was getting processed...
Speranski was in his dining room...
Reacher could see it so clearly now...
Reacher walked up the path leading to the house...
Reacher left Rutherford in the car like he was a kid...
Rutherford's text arrived after five minutes...
The Suburban was still parked in the same spot...
The clock in his head woke Reacher...
There were two people at the kitchen counter...
Reacher, Rutherford, and Sands left the guy...
The GPS predicted a twenty-two-minute drive to Fat Freddie's...
The GPS directed them back to the same side of town...
There were five words on Reacher's mind...
What do you guys know about a thing...
Reacher woke himself the next morning...
Reacher tracked down the biker Klostermann's housekeeper...
Reacher had spent plenty of time in places he didn't want to be...
It was the calm before the storm...
Rusty Rutherford emerged from his apartment...
